title: Camera system overhaul
features: Matching upcoming-camera map markers: crisp supersampled icons for Speed, Red-light and Average-speed cameras appear on the map for the upcoming camera (or average-zone exit) and turn red when over the limit.
Sleek flush 43 px camera card: aligned with the Speed and Turn pills, with matching icons, clean limit readouts, a BT-CTRL-style capsule progress bar and a synced pulsing red overspeed rim.

Smarter detection & reliability: speed-scaled warning and chime horizons, curved-road unguided matching, high-speed 1 Hz average-speed entry, along-route zone distance with slip-road auto-clear, and exact overspeed parity.

Two-tier chimes & Overspeed audio: distinct approach vs overspeed Bluetooth audio cues, plus a new Overspeed audio mode (quiet when compliant on speed/average cameras; soft cue only for red-light cameras).
